_comment: Retrieval recall baseline on the real knowledge base (BM25 + semantic + reranker). 'phrase' must appear in the text of one of the top `within` passages; 'clause_top1' must be the clause of the best passage. 'abstain' cases must score below retrieval.min_score so the agent abstains instead of guessing.
